mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is used to determine the structure and arrangement of rock strata.

A chain is made up of steel or iron pieces of wire known as links which are joined together with circular or oval rings that make for flexibility.
Fill in the blank: ______ is made up of a wooden or metallic rule of about 50-75cm day, with vanes at the ends.
Plain Alidade is made up of a wooden or metallic rule of about 50-75cm day, with vanes at the ends.

The level is an instrument used to accurately determine the difference in elevation between two points on the earth's surface.
